AI paradigms into seamless user experiences.

* Design, orchestrate, and deploy production-ready agentic workflows that leverage LLM

* Develop core full-stack components that interface with Generative AI model deployment and real-time inference systems. Optimize large-scale AI interactions for performance, low latency, and high throughput.

* Champion design standards, rigorous type safety, automated testing, and comprehensive monitoring across decoupled repositories, UI components, and AI inference pipelines.

* Lead deep technical design reviews, perform high-impact code reviews, mentor engineers, and foster a culture of engineering excellence and continuous learning.

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of operating at a Staff, or Tech Lead level.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience designing, fine-tuning, and building autonomous AIagentic solutions, LLM architectures, and RAG pipelines in a production setting.
* Expert-level experience with Java and Spring Boot (or equivalent enterprise frameworks like Go or advanced Node.js) building resilient distributed systems and secure RESTful APIs. Experience with SQL (MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra) schema design and performance tuning.
* Deep experience building complex, production-grade web applications using React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Node.js. Strong understanding of SSR (Server-Side Rendering).
* State management, and building intuitive, responsive interfaces for data-dense AI workflows.
* Strong experience designing and deploying distributed systems on Google Cloud Platform, specifically using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) or Cloud Run, alongside modern CI/CD tools (Harness, Jenkins).
* A strong focus on the end-user. You understand how to handle the unique UI/UX challenges of Generative AI, such as streaming model responses, conversational state management, and elegant fallback UI states.
* Exceptional ability to articulate complex technical, cloud, and AI concepts to both deeply technical engineers and non-technical business stakeholders.

* Proficiency in Python for backend development, quick AI prototyping, and data
* processing.
* Experience with open-source AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity principles for AI applications.

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead
description:
Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead at Monay

Location: Kakinada or Hyderabad, India

Work arrangement: On-site, full-time

Monay is building two connected products: a wallet for enterprise and consumer payments, and a blockchain settlement layer that links payments to invoices and records confirmed money movement.

We need a strong engineer who can lead a small team in India and write production code every week. You’ll work directly with our US-based founder and team, make technical decisions and take responsibility for getting features delivered.

What the role involves

You’ll lead and mentor 3–5 engineers across Monay Wallet and Monay Blockchain. The work includes wallet applications, backend services, ledger integrations and smart contracts.

Our stack includes TypeScript, Next.js, React Native with Expo, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Rust, TigerBeetle and Solidity. We use Foundry, Hardhat and Arbitrum Orbit/Stylus across the blockchain work.

You’ll be expected to:

• Take features from specification through implementation, testing and release.

• Review code carefully and keep pull requests small enough to review properly.

• Protect payment and ledger correctness as the products grow.

• Use Claude Code or comparable AI coding agents daily, and verify what they produce.

• Help your team solve problems, improve their work and meet commitments.

• Raise blockers early and take the initiative to resolve them.

Who we’re looking for

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years leading or mentoring engineers.

• Strong, current coding skills in TypeScript/Node.js or Rust, with a willingness to work in both.

• Practical experience with AI coding agents in everyday engineering.

• Exposure to Ethereum/EVM, Solidity and smart contract tooling.

• A solid understanding of APIs, relational databases and testing.

• Clear written English and dependable communication.

• A record of taking ownership and finishing difficult work without constant supervision.

Payments, fintech, double-entry accounting, reconciliation, wallet integrations, TigerBeetle or Arbitrum experience would be useful.

Please read this before applying

This is a demanding startup role. It is not a routine 8-to-5 position where responsibility ends when the working day does. There will be tight deadlines, difficult problems and periods that require additional effort to get a release over the line.

We’re looking for someone dedicated, focused and highly motivated. You should be comfortable starting work without waiting for detailed instructions, making decisions and being accountable for the result.

Commitment means delivering consistently, helping the team and maintaining quality when the pressure is on. We care about what you accomplish and whether people can depend on you.

Employment and stock options

You’ll initially be employed by Tilli Software India. The role will move to Monay India once the local entity is established.

After two years, you may qualify for Monay stock options based on your dedication, performance, leadership and consistency. Eligibility and any grant are subject to review, approval and the terms of Monay’s stock option plan. Completing two years does not automatically qualify you for a grant.

You’ll have the opportunity to help build our India engineering team and earn greater responsibility as the company grows.

How to apply

Send your CV to both hr@tilli.pro and talent@Monay.com, along with links to code you’ve written and a short note telling us:

• About a difficult feature or product you personally delivered.

• How you use Claude Code or other AI coding agents.

• Why this kind of role appeals to you.

• Whether you prefer Kakinada or Hyderabad.
